cases.name: Gertude McCabe
cases.narrative: On 10/23/1983, she was discovered deceased, and had been bludgeoned, stabbed more than ninety times in the face and neck with a butcher knife, smothered with a pillow and strangled with a bicycle chain encased in plastic.

cases.name: Jeannette Ralston
cases.about:
Allen Ralston said he holds the memory of his mother close to his heart.

“She raised me to be a happy kid, so I just held onto that,” he said. “I’ve always tried to do good in my life and try to respect her in any way I could.”
cases.narrative: Her body was found in the back seat of her Volkswagen Beetle. He allegedly strangled her to death with a shirt.
